outcomes.outcome: nginx comes from the distribution's archive (manage_repo false), with no nginx.org repository added
nginx is installed and runs with a configuration that passes nginx -t, dynamic modules loaded once
worker processes are auto, and nginx sends no version in its Server header (server_tokens off)
the main and compact log formats are defined for the servers to use
the Diffie-Hellman group /etc/nginx/dhparams.pem has dh_params_bits (2048) bits and is readable by owner and group only
with no ad-hoc configuration given, the ad-hoc file is absent
the stream block logs nothing (stream_access_log off, HQ 2026-11-18 ruling A1, a module-compatibility change in class_rulings.txt)

uncovered.why: the stream block exists only when a stream server is declared, which is another class's resource, not a parameter of this one
uncovered.lifted_by: capability: a stream server declared alongside nginx_base in a run (a variant varies the class's own params only)
uncovered.evidence: nginx_frontend_mail declares stream servers; its set's check streams-listen-and-stream-access-log-off shows access_log off in the stream block (review PASS)

outcomes.outcome: additional log formats and another DH size

uncovered.why: parameter variants no production node uses (the fixture keeps the default 2048 bits and the two formats)
uncovered.evidence: diagnosis/fleet_variant_usage.md (2026-11-23): no production node statement sets either, and no class of the repository sets them on nginx_base
